{{Quote|I see you managed to pull Adi Gallia away from her pirate friends.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Obsession">[[Obsession 4|''Obsession'' 4]]</ref>}}
The '''Lok Revenants''' were a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] operating out of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] in the [[Karthakk system]] before, during and after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and were led by the pirate [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Nym/Legends|Nym]].

==History==
===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|Nym is the most feared pirate in the Maramere system. He routed the Trade Federation from Lok and its neighboring planets right around the start of the Clone Wars, and he's maintained complete control over the spacelanes in this region ever since.|[[Vana Sage]]|<ref name="SWG:MVS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Meet Vana Sage|Lok}}</ref>}}
[[File:Starfighters_Nod_Kartha.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Revenants starfighters above [[Nod Kartha]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].]]
The Lok Revenants were loyal to Nym, and aided the pirate captain on many [[Occupation of Karthakk|raids]] against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. They defended [[Nym's Base]] on Lok from a large invasion force, and though eventually [[Battle of Lok (32 BBY)|overwhelmed]], the Revenants regrouped and continued the fight. The Lok Revenants soon after participated in the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] <ref name="SWS" />; while the Trade Federation was struck a big blow at the battle, they still remained a sizable presence in the Karthakk system. For the next ten years, the Revenants waged war with the Federation.<ref name="SWJS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''</ref>

It was not until [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] intervened that the tide began to turn. By now, the Revenants were joined by [[Sol Sixxa]] and the [[Mere Resistance]], and launched an [[Battle of Nod Kartha|assault]] against the heavily defended factory world of [[Nod Kartha]]. They later participated in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]] over [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], helping to defeat Captain [[Cavik Toth]] and his [[Sabaoth Squadron/Legends|Sabaoth Squadron]]. Ultimately, Nym's forces [[Battle of Lok (22 BBY)|recovered]] their base on Lok, and Nym remained in contact with Master Gallia.<ref name="SWJS" />

===Imperial Era===
{{Quote|There's nobody with more power on Lok. And except for Jabba the Hutt, he's probably the most powerful alien in the Outer Rim.|Vana Sage, about Nym|<ref name="SWG:MVS" />}}
[[File:Lok_Revenants_leaders.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Leaders of the Lok Revenants, including [[Nym]], [[Kole]] and [[Jinkins]].]]
After the end of the Clone Wars and the defeat of the Trade Federation, the Lok Revenants definitively assumed control of Lok and Nym then shared his time between ruling the planet and leading his criminal activities.<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|65|Who's Who in Star Wars Galaxies|Who's Who in ''Star Wars'' Galaxies}}</ref> In the following years, Nym's old base was turned into a palace while a small city known as [[Nym's Stronghold]] was built nearby. Defended by the Lok Revenants, the city became the major [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on Lok and access to the planet was controlled by an orbital [[Lok Station|space station]].<ref name="SCKS" /> On the other hand, the Lok Revenants pursued their pirate and criminal activities beyond the Karthakk system, frequently attacking ships along the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]].<ref name="TRoD">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Ruins of Dantooine]]''</ref> During one of these raids, taking place in the Maramere system, the pirates [[Battle of the Karthakk System|attacked]] the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], forcing the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] to flee the ship using an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The raid was therefore directly responsible for the droids being separated from the [[House of Organa/Legends|Alderaanian royal family]] and involved in many adventures throughout the galaxy.<ref name="reanimated">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> The Lok Revenants sometimes sold weapons and vehicles to rebel groups such as [[Kota's Militia]].

Sometime after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], the planet Lok fell under the control of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Empire built a [[Imperial Outpost (Lok)|small base]] on Lok and deployed a garrison on the planet. However, despite his disdain for the Empire, Nym successfully arranged an understanding with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Otto]], the Imperial officer in charge of the planet. As both parties agreed with not interfering with the affairs of the other, the cohabitation between the Lok Revenants and the Empire was peaceful. Hence, Nym remained the effective ruler of the planet.<ref name="Insider" />

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|The Sulfur Lake Pirates and Nym never exactly saw eye to eye. We want to let them know who still runs this planet.|[[Mako Ghast]]|<ref name="SWG:KtBT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Kill the Bridge Troll|Lok}}</ref>}}
[[File:Nym_guards.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Nym's guards patrolling in [[Nym's Stronghold]].]]
The situation became more complicated during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Revenants considered themselves neutral in the conflict but Nym was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sympathizer. While the Revenants were not challenged by General Otto on Lok,<ref name="Insider" /> the organization was targeted by other Imperial units, in particular from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the operation of the Revenants in the [[Karthakk system]] were severely crippled by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Oberhaur]]'s [[Storm Squadron/Legends|Storm Squadron]].<ref name="SWG:SS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Storm Squadron}}</ref> A short time later, Officer [[Haymir Rendundi]] of the Imperial special [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] [[Black Epsilon]] triggered a war between the Lok Revenants and the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] in order to weaken the support of Nym to the Rebellion. This conflict began after an Imperial pilot hijacked a Hutt starship and used it to attack Revenant vessels in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]].<ref name="SWG:BE">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Black Epsilon}}</ref> In response, Nym supported the operations of [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Viopa]] and [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] of [[Havoc Squadron]] in the Karthakk system.<ref name="SWG:HS">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Havoc Squadron}}</ref> Furthermore, the Lok Revenants attempted to expand their activities beyond the Karthakk system. During that time, the Revenant [[Nirame Sakute]] received help from [[Talon Karrde]]'s [[Smugglers' Alliance|Smuggler Alliance]] to assist Nym's operations in the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]].<ref name="SWG:SA">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Smuggler Alliance}}</ref>

Nym and the Revenants also targeted directly Imperial interests during the Galactic Civil War. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Lok Revenants raided an [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial mine]] on Lok where the release of an unknown toxic gas had made the [[Mining/Legends|miners]] become completely crazy and very hostile. The criminals collected a sample of the gas from the mine filtration system in order to study it and use it as a weapon if possible.<ref name="SWG:RtMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Mine Filter|Lok}}</ref> Later, the Revenants attacked a secret [[Imperial Research Facility (Lok)|Imperial research facility]] on Lok to steal experimental weapons developed there such as [[Imperial Military Grade Grenade Casing Unit]]s.<ref name="SWG:RtrdaI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the research data and IMGGCUs|Lok}}</ref> These attacks likely did not affect the deal between Nym and General Otto since the existence of the mining and research facilities had been kept hidden to Otto by Imperial authorities.<ref name="SWG:SwSMA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Sergeant Moore, again|Lok}}</ref>

[[File:SWG_quest_Envoy.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]] attack [[Nym's Base|Nym's palace]].]]
During the Galactic Civil War, the Lok Revenants also had trouble with a rival criminal organization, the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]]. Known as the most bloodthirsty and least-intelligent pirates on Lok, they contested the position of the Nym as the ruler of Lok and the Karthakk system. Although they were clearly weaker than the Revenants, they aspired to overthrow Nym. For years, Nym had always tried to minimize the hostility between the two groups as much as possible in order to avoid a bloody and useless war on Lok.<ref name="SWG:MVS" /> However, in 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the Lok Revenants assaulted the [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|hideout]] of the Sulfur Lake Pirates to retrieve the valuable [[memory module]] of an Imperial [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Thanks to the help of [[Choster]], the [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who had set up the defenses of the base for the pirates before they betrayed him, [[Vana Sage]]'s henchmen infiltrated the hideout. They eventually found the memory module they were looking for but they killed numerous pirates during the mission.<ref name="SWG:RtDD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Retrieve the Droid Disk|Lok}}</ref> After the attack on the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout, the tensions between the two criminal groups turned to open war. Finally, Nym grew weary of the situation and proposed a truce to the Sulfur Lake Pirates. A meeting was arranged in [[Kimogila Town]], an abandoned city in the deserts of Lok. Nevertheless, not long before the meeting took place, the pirates captured [[Sheeli]], the sister of the engineer Choster. When the meeting began, the Sulfur Lake emissary [[Cale Serasai]] revealed that they had captured Sheeli and ordered the Revenants to hand over Choster. As they refused, many Sulfur Lake Pirates hidden in the ruins of Kimogila Town then suddenly attacked Nym's ambassadors. Although the Revenant spacers were outnumbered, they successfully defended themselves and killed all the pirates. The only survivor was Cale Serasai, who begged to be spared and agreed to release Sheeli in exchange for his life.<ref name="SWG:NP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Negotiate Peace|Lok}}</ref> After this humiliation, Nym thought that the Sulfur Lake Pirates would try to strike back soon. A short time later, Nym planned to receive an envoy of politicians from [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in his palace on Lok. Yet, the pirates hijacked the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of the Tatooinan and landed it in the courtyard of Nym's palace. As Nym and other leaders of the Lok Revenants arrived to greet the envoys, the pirates unexpectedly emerged from the shuttle and attacked the Revenants in the palace. Finally, Nym, [[Kole]], Vana Sage, [[Jinkins]] and other Lok Revenants eliminated every Sulfur Lake Pirates.<ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Envoy|Lok}}</ref>

Beyond the Sulfur Lake Pirates, the Lok Revenants were also enemies of other pirates groups such as the [[Blood Razors]] and the [[Canyon Corsairs]].<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref> On the other hand, Nym formed an alliance with the [[Detritus Satellites]], a group of independent [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|''Vulture''-class droids]], in the [[Dantooine system/Legends|Dantooine system]].<ref name="SWG:AAA">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Alliance Agreement}}</ref>

==Members==
{{Quote|The pay? You are indeed my type of pirate-spacer-garbage. The pay is okay. Occasionally when you don't make me mad it will be better. Still interested?''"<br />"''I very much want to be a Lok Revenant, sir!|Nym and a spacer|<ref name="SWG:StN">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Nym|Lok}}</ref>}}
The Lok Revenants were founded and commanded by the Feeorin pirate captain and warlord Nym.<ref name="TNEGtC" /> His most loyal lieutenants were the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] Jinkins, the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] Kole and the Human female Vana Sage. Kole and Jinkins were the most ancient members of the organization, the former served as Nym's [[First Mate/Legends|first mate]] and the latter worked as chief engineer. Vana Sage joined the Revenants by the time of the Invasion of Naboo and later became Nym's head of security. Three decades later Kole, Jinkins and Vana Sage still worked for Nym at the height of the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG:MVS" /><ref name="SWG:FJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Jinkins|Lok}}</ref><ref name="SWG:FK">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Find Kole|Lok}}</ref>

[[File:Nym_palace_3.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Lok Revenants in Nym's palace.]]
Beyond Nym's most trusted lieutenants, membership among the Revenants was in a constant state of flux.<ref name="Insider" /> During the Galactic Civil War, four important lieutenants of the organizations were [[Mako Ghast]], [[Rek Thelcar]], [[Stuvany Inglen]] and [[Grenz Zittoun]].<ref name="SWG:KtBT" /><ref name="SWG:RtLR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Rescue the Lok Revenant|Lok}}</ref><ref name="SWG:EB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Embarrassing Breakup|Lok}}</ref><ref name="SWG:PtSD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Place the Surveillance Devices|Lok}}</ref> Other Lok Revenants included the engineer [[Phor Cl-lan]],<ref name="SWG:PIP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Parts Is Parts|Lok}}</ref> the pilot trainer Nirame Sakute<ref name="SWG:SA" /> the [[Martial artist/Legends|brawling]] master [[Rydel Delan]],<ref name="SWG:StILtGW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak to Inaldra's Lieutenant to Get Work|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> and [[Ran Machado]].<ref name="SWG:WWFR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Weed Whacker Foliage Requisition|Lok}}</ref> [[Vors d'Oesti]] commanded Nym's operations in the Dantooine system.<ref name="SWG:AAA" />

The Revenants were also allied with the [[Reeven Clan]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan led by [[Jannik (Rodian)|Jannik the White]], since before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SC">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones]]''</ref> During the Galactic Civil War, two members of the clan, [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] [[Ralia Reeven|Ralia]] and field [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Rei Reeven]], had joined the Revenants on Lok.<ref name="SWG:SM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Save Me|Lok}}</ref>

==Military==
{{Quote|A direct assault on Nym will have the desired effect but could also be costly for us as well. That is just the sort of advantage that the Rebels are waiting for.|[[Haymir Rendundi]], to an Imperial pilot|<ref name="SWG:BE" />}}
[[File:Lok_Revenant_Scurrg_H-6_Bomber_XWM.png|thumb|right|250px|A pair of Lok Revenant [[Scurrg H-6 Bomber/Legends|Scurrg H-6 prototype bombers]] conducting a raid]]
The Lok Revenants used various types of starships and vehicles. In the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era, they made use of [[G-400]] starfighters, [[Scurrg H-6 Bomber/Legends|Scurrg H-6 prototype bombers]] (such as Nym's [[Havoc (starfighter)|''Havoc'']]), [[Sigil (starfighter)|Sigil]] and [[Velker (starfighter)|Velker]] fighters, [[mechanized drone fighter]]s, [[Freefall-class bomber|''Freefall''-class bombers]] (like Jinkins' ''[[Freefall]]''), and [[Revenant Speeder]]s. In addition, Vana Sage piloted an unique starship named ''[[Guardian Mantis]]''.<ref name="SWS" />

During the Galactic Civil War, the Revenants invested in more modern vessels such as [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95-AF4 Headhunters]], [[M3-A Scyk interceptor/Legends|M3-A Scyk fighters]], [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]], [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]]s, [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighters]], [[M12-L Kimogila heavy fighter]]s,<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref> [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighters]], such as the ''[[Happy Lady]]'',<ref name="SWG:SftTP3">{{SWGcite|exp=RotW|type=space|Smuggling for the Trandoshans Part III|Lok system}}</ref> [[X4 Gunship/Legends|X4 Gunships]], including the ''[[Karthakk Queen]]'',<ref name="SWG:DtKQ">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Destroy the Karthakk Queen|Lok system}}</ref> and [[HC-556 Light Cruiser]]s.<ref name="SWG:CtHT">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=space|Capture the Hostage Transport|Lok system}}</ref>
